description: This file defines a PHP class EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams that extends FilterParams, used for filtering emergency contact search results in an HRM system. It includes properties for employee number and contact name, with corresponding getter and setter methods, and specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering emergency contact search results by employee number and contact name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'eec.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
